lead: Kid Cudi is a widely followed American rapper, born on 30 January 1984 in Cleveland.
As of 2026, he is 42 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Grammy Award for Best Melodic Rap Performance.
This profile collects the Kid facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Kid Cudi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kid Cudi was born on 30 January 1984 in Cleveland, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Scott Ramón Seguro Mescudi at birth and is publicly known as Kid Cudi.
He received his education at University of Toledo, Solon High School and Shaker Heights High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Kid Cudi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer, actor and fashion designer as his occupations, including work with Dean & DeLuca.
He performs on drum machine and voice.
